scope: Read-only integration review of catalogue recovery, final planner accounting, console ACK/close changes; no production edits or new engine ABI/address work.

findings.condition: An accepted World contains a duplicate far harvester Actor with the same unit/token, and the refinery exposes at least two free waiting cells.
findings.reason: New trucks become duplicate OreJob entries. Before this patch, the first OreYield updates turn.sent and throttles a second candidate; moving the update to merge removes that suppression.
findings.baseline: validWorld=1; frame 500/530/560 each emits 1; total=3, attempts=3.
findings.changed: validWorld=1; frame 500/530 each emits 2 for the same unit/token, destinations 40020/40021; total=4, attempts=4 > MaxDockAttempts=3.
findings.status: Resolved by async owner. Independently recompiled public Planner counterexample: one yield in each frame 500/530/560; total 3 and attempts 3. Source/test inputs unchanged during compile and run.
findings.resolution: At candidate creation, bounded any_of over <=32 orders checks existing OreYield for the same refinery before choosing or reserving another waiting cell. First candidate order is preserved; final-merge-only accounting remains. Regular ore loop already excludes both displaced and unreleased winner, preventing a second regular-order path.

findings.reason: Failed rebuild invalidates Snapshot, TypeIndex and successful stamp state; prevBuildings commits only on success. Required vector count/capacity bounds fit PtrList. Empty vectors and known filtering remain valid. Appended diagnostic preserves prior enum ordinals.
findings.coverage: Public Sampler: building visibility toggle; failed toggle and next-sample recovery; diagnostic; match preservation; irrelevant hidden building metadata failure; explicitly forced oversized-count rebuild failure and recovery.
findings.limits: Periodic failed catalogue stamp retaining a prior good table is pre-existing policy and outside the successful-stamp/failed-rebuild correction. The initial scratch bounds scenario did not trigger a rebuild; final scenario explicitly does.

findings.reason: State only settles acknowledged request; ACK additionally matches module/id/seq/generation and uses certified revision. This matches native publisher draining 32 ACKs before a state. Native accepted actions force a new capture and require p.revision+1. Close counts compare draft against current same-generation page and preserve unknown or retired draft ownership. Range comparison follows existing numeric actualValue; text comparison follows existing commit semantics.
findings.review_method: Read source diff, new receipt-order tests, native console_adapter acknowledgement/capture and modern_console_main publication ordering. Did not rerun already-passed frontend suite.
